jcr:description:
We understand the unique challenges and difficult demands that you manage on a daily basis. OnSite offers customized workflow solutions to mitigate these challenges within the operating room and sterile processing department, so your staff can focus on what they do best – caring for patients.

Contact your local Endoscopy Sales Representative for more information about our managed service opportunities.

largeheadline.line1: OnSite empowers your OR team to prioritize exceptional patient care.1 Our dedicated OnSite Specialists work to prevent top operating room challenges like workflow inefficiencies, OR technology management, and communication gaps. We offer customized solutions to optimize your Sterile Processing Department and support seamless OR integration. Stryker OnSite aims to maximize efficiency, reduce costs, and provide more time for your team to focus on what matters most.​

largeheadline_185133.line1: Better together
largeheadline_185133.line2: OnSite is focused on driving opportunities to decrease the peri-operative interruptions that have a negative impact on your facility financially, operationally and clinically. Our capabilities include:

text.text:
• Pre/Intra/Post operative equipment support including Stryker Integration and Connectivity for camera and rigid scope procedures.
  • Equipment setup, troubleshooting breakdown
  • Repair & Media Management

text_copy.text:
• Decontamination and assembly of identified MIS instrumentation/devices.
  • Support may include Urology Flexible scopes and da Vinci Robotic Inventory

• Runs MIS instrumentation to and from SPD/Sterile Storage to the OR
  • Pre/Intra/Post operative MIS case support
  • Communication of MIS instrumentation turnover needs between the OR and SPD

• Pre/Post operative equipment support
  • Decontamination and Prep/Pack of battery inventory within SPD.
  • Decontamination and Prep/Pack of Stryker Power devices and accessories including both Stryker Power and Neuro Power inventory

• Full OR case load picking and staging of soft supplies and instrumentation
  • Instrumentation returns
  • Communication of critical turnovers and general instrumentation needs between the OR and SPD

• Pre/Intra/Post operative equipment routing and connectivity. May include robotic inventory management.
  • Decontamination and Prep/Pack of da Vinci arms, scopes, and accessories.
• OnSite Specialists drive disposable collection and compliance through in-service trainings and managing the collection, shipping process, and replacement of Advantage bins within the OR.

text_copy_copy.text:
• Surgical visualization
  • Integration and connectivity
  • Power tools
  • Surgical tables
  • Booms and lights
  • Urology flexible scopes
  • Robotic instrumentation
